t: You're on Kennington Park Road, a main road in south London and part of the A3 trunk road. It runs south-west from Newington Butts, where it meets Kennington Lane in a Y-junction, down to the Oval. At that crossroads the A3 carries on as Clapham Road towards Stockwell, while Camberwell New Road and Kennington Oval lead off towards Camberwell Green and Vauxhall. John Marmion Anthony Powell, born in 1946, is recorded as having lived on this road.
